acceptance_criteria.criterion: The constructor no longer directly references APP_DB_USER, APP_DB_NAME, or APP_DB_HOST — it delegates to resolveConnectionInfo().
resolveConnectionInfo() calls DBHelper::getSelectedDB() and formats the result as username@name on host using the array keys username, name, and host.

If DBHelper::getSelectedDB() throws (e.g., no DB selected during early boot), resolveConnectionInfo() catches \Throwable and returns the fallback string using APP_DB_USER, APP_DB_NAME, and APP_DB_HOST constants.
When the test database is the selected DB and a DB error occurs, the error message displays the test database name (not the main application database name).

summary: Replaced the hardcoded APP_DB_USER/APP_DB_NAME/APP_DB_HOST constant reference in the constructor with a call to the new resolveConnectionInfo() method.

Added private resolveConnectionInfo() method that calls DBHelper::getSelectedDB() and formats the result as 'username@name on host'. Falls back to APP_DB_USER/APP_DB_NAME/APP_DB_HOST constants if getSelectedDB() throws (e.g., no DB selected at early boot).
Verified DBHelper::getSelectedDB() return type is array{name:string,username:string,password:string,host:string,port:int} — array keys used match exactly.
PHPStan analysis: the only error reported is a pre-existing issue on the analyzeQuery() method (missing iterable value type on $values), unrelated to this change. New code passes cleanly.
